title: Session Evidence Turn (v1)
description: Persisted tool-evidence group for one assistant turn, returned in the additive evidence_turns field of GET /api/v2/sessions/{id} (SPEC-025 R-2). Frames follow the tool_call/tool_result shapes of agent-stream-event.schema.json; the evidence store may add a truncation marker where a size cap replaced a payload (SPEC-025 R-1), never silently drop a frame.

turn_index.description: Assistant turn ordinal the evidence belongs to (0-based); replay attaches the group to that transcript turn.

request_id.description: Request that produced the evidence; correlates with the audit trail tool_invoked events.

created_at.description: Persistence timestamp assigned by the evidence store.

frames.description: Ordered tool_call/tool_result frames as they appeared on the live stream, persisted within the entry and session size caps.

truncated.description: Store-added size marker; absent on frames stored whole.

reason.description: entry_cap: the per-entry cap replaced an oversized data payload with a truncated preview. session_budget: the per-session budget evicted the oldest result payload; metadata is preserved and data is null.

original_chars.description: Serialized size of the original data payload; present for entry_cap truncation.
